## Summary

BRUNALDO TRADE IMPEX SRL (fictional) scores 67.8 (RED) with 8/8 sources available. High signals appear in tax and litigation. The band is not STOP: the insolvency procedure is requested, not opened.

## Red signals

- ANAF requested insolvency in case 9101/99/2026 (first instance, next hearing 2026-11-20). If the procedure is opened, the band becomes STOP. [LIT-INSOLVENCY-REQUEST-01]
- On the Q2 2026 ANAF arrears list: 412,560 RON principal and 96,300 RON accessories. [TAX-ARREARS-01] (MOCK source)
- Submitted 2025 net result +300,000 RON vs -2,600,000 RON at ANAF. [TAX-DECLARED-GAP-01]
- Supplier claim of 1,800,000 RON on appeal in case 9102/99/2025. [LIT-MATERIAL-CLAIM-01]

## Yellow signals

- Turnover fell from 29,100,000 RON (2023) to 15,200,000 RON (2025), with net losses in 2023-2025. [FIN-REVENUE-DECLINE-01, FIN-LOSS-TREND-01]
- VAT cancelled on 2025-02-01, re-registered on 2025-09-15. D300 is 18% below e-Factura. [TAX-VAT-CANCELLED-01, TAX-EFACTURA-GAP-01]
- Sole shareholder Calbrona Holding Fictiv SRL is ANAF inactive. [NET-PARTNER-INACTIVE-01]
- Labour dispute pending (case 9103/99/2025). [LIT-MINOR-01]
- **Unvalidated:** an article published on 2026-03-03 reports unpaid suppliers. [MED-NEGATIVE-01]

## Coverage

All 8 agents completed. MOCK sources used: tax arrears list, D300, e-Factura, BPI, shareholders.
